record.dic_text:
05858 `Eybal {ay-bawl'}

可能源於一已不使用的字根, 其意可能為 禿的;

AV - Ebal 8; 8

以巴錄 = "石頭" 或 "禿山"
陽性專有名詞
1) 朔巴的一個兒子 (#創 36:23;代上 1:40|)
2) 約坍的一個兒子 (#代上 1:22|)

專有名詞 地名 (以巴路山)
2) 咒詛之山, 在示劍以北, 和基利心山相對
record.edic_text:
05858 `Eybal {ay-bawl'}

perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be bald;

AV - Ebal 8; 8

Ebal = "stone" or "bare mountain"
n pr m
1) a son of Shobal
n pr loc
2) mountain of cursing, north of Shechem and opposite Mount Gerizim
